note: Re-judged 2026-11-14 by an independent auditor who authored neither 08fe903803 nor the uncommitted phase 2 of spec-single-owner-lifecycle-2-bgp-session. RFC 4659 Section 3.4 read: "In order for two PEs to exchange labeled IPv6 VPN NLRIs, they MUST use BGP Capabilities Negotiation to ensure that they both are capable of properly processing such NLRIs." Units read: TestRFC4659VPNv6RouteSentWhenNegotiated and TestRFC4659VPNv6RouteWithheldWhenNotNegotiated; only their initial-sync call changed. 08fe903803 moved the initial-sync gate (sendingInitialRoutes) and the End-of-RIB owed mark (initialSyncEOROwed) from Peer onto Session. In the tagged units named stale it replaced peer.sendInitialRoutes() with peer.runInitialSyncNow(), which is Peer.sendInitialRoutes(p.testInitialSync()) (initial_sync_helpers_test.go): the same production sync body, run on the session the fixture installed (or one built with NewSession(p.settings) and published through establishedSession as enterEstablished does); it replaced peer.<flag>.Store(v) with peer.testInitialSync().<flag>.Store(v) or setTestInitialSync, and drainAndCloseQueueGate now takes that session. git diff 08fe903803^ against the working tree shows no assertion, expected byte, driven input or tag prose changed in any of them, each under the RFC-approved line 08fe903803 carries. Questions 1, 3 and 4 answer exactly as the earlier judgement below; question 2 still rests on the same producers, whose discrimination records are retaken by ./le rfc record after this stamp. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgement follows. Re-judged 2026-10-14 (independent auditor). Only TestOpenAdvertisesVPNv6Capability changed, mechanically: it now packs ps.Capabilities through capability.PackOptionalParams (the one packer buildOpen uses) instead of the removed buildOptionalParams, then requires Multiprotocol AFI 2/SAFI 128 in the decoded OPEN parameters for a configured ipv6/mpls-vpn family. The send and receive units in rfc4659_vpnv6_negotiated_send_test.go (route sent only when AFI 2/SAFI 128 negotiated, UPDATE refused when not) and the negotiateWith negative are unchanged and still carry the enforcement.
